narr: Southeast low level flow brought in some Gulf moisture to the region. Aloft, there was an upper level trough located near the International Border. Slow moving storms developed near the Rio Grande Valley and brought heavy rain and flash flooding to the Rincon area. Meanwhile, outflows into drier air toward Deming and the Arizona border brought gusty winds and a couple of dust storms to the Lordsburg Playa.
